sprint.name: Sprint 1 — Foundation & First Paper Trade
sprint.goal: Deliver a working bot skeleton that can fetch market data, run SMA strategy, enforce basic policy, and place paper trades.

issues.title: Create repo skeleton with Docker & Poetry
issues.description: Initialize repo with src/, tests/, docs/, configs/, docker-compose. Add Dockerfile + Poetry for dependencies.
issues.definition_of_done: Repo created; `docker-compose up` runs placeholder app printing 'hello world'.

issues.title: Add CI/CD pipeline
issues.description: Set up GitHub Actions for lint, test, build on pull requests and main branch.
issues.definition_of_done: Pull requests automatically trigger lint & unit tests successfully.

issues.title: Connect to Alpaca Market Data API
issues.description: Implement data provider module with function to fetch OHLCV bars for a symbol.
issues.definition_of_done: `python -m src.data.providers.alpaca fetch AAPL` prints OHLCV bars to console.

issues.title: Connect to Alpaca Paper Trading API
issues.description: Implement order client to place a market order with sandbox account.
issues.definition_of_done: Test script places a $1 notional trade in Alpaca paper account and logs order id.

issues.title: Implement SMA crossover function
issues.description: Create function to compute SMA fast/slow and return buy/sell/none signals.
issues.definition_of_done: Unit test shows correct buy/sell/none signal on sample CSV data.

issues.title: Integrate SMA into bot loop
issues.description: Wire strategy into app scheduler; on each tick, compute signal using Alpaca data.
issues.definition_of_done: When running bot, SMA signals (buy/sell/none) are printed to logs.

issues.title: Create policy engine module
issues.description: Implement placeholder policy checks (always returns ok).
issues.definition_of_done: All trade signals pass through policy engine; log shows 'policy=ok'.

issues.title: Add max notional check
issues.description: Implement limit: max notional $1000 per trade.
issues.definition_of_done: Signal exceeding notional is blocked and logged in audit.

issues.title: Wire signal → policy → order
issues.description: Complete loop: strategy → policy → Alpaca order → log result.
issues.definition_of_done: Running bot places valid trade in Alpaca paper account, logs full decision trace.

issues.title: Structured audit logging
issues.description: Log every decision in JSON format (strategy, policy decision, order result).
issues.definition_of_done: Audit log file contains JSON entries per tick with timestamp.

issues.title: Run 1-day paper demo
issues.description: Deploy bot with Docker Compose, run for 1 day using Alpaca sandbox.
issues.definition_of_done: Audit logs show trades executed with SMA strategy; policy enforced.

issues.title: Sprint 1 Review & Documentation
issues.description: Write README with setup/run instructions, update docs with Sprint 1 outcomes.
issues.definition_of_done: Docs explain how to build, run, validate Sprint 1 bot.
